message.content:
Here are some of the most significant airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Key gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the world; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas/Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest single-runway airports. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; major hub for United and Southwest. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York, NY | JFK | Primary gateway to Europe and the Caribbean; major hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United and a key gateway to Asia; known for its sustainability initiatives. |
| **Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle, WA | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta; known for its eco-friendly design. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for Southwest and a key gateway to theme parks and tourism. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; primary gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston, TX | IAH | Major hub for United Airlines; one of the busiest airports in Texas. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the Southeast. |
| **McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas, NV | LAS | Major hub for Southwest; key gateway to the entertainment capital of the world. |

These airports are not only the busiest in terms of passenger numbers but also serve as critical hubs for domestic and international travel, connecting the United States to the rest of the world.
